title: Empirical workload suites and CI performance guardrails for serving runtime
creator: Diego Morales
description: Goal: make our benchmarking harness produce deterministic, production-representative throughput/latency baselines and enforce regressions via CI. Deliver an empirical workload suite (prefill+decode patterns, KV cache priming, batching distributions), a set of immutable golden baselines per target model/hardware, and automated CI perf gates that fail PRs on >5% regression against the golden baseline. This ticket coordinates work across kernel selection, attention microbenchmarks, and prefill/decode scheduler measurements to ensure the baselines capture meaningful regressions and avoid noise.
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible workload suite executable in CI that covers at minimum: short-chat-style (<=128 tokens), long-context prefill (>=4096 tokens), streaming decode heavy (low-latency 1-token ops), and KV-heavy prefix reuse scenarios.
Golden baseline artifacts stored in S3 with schema and versioning; each baseline tagged by model, quantization profile, hardware label, and runtime build hash.

CI perf gate pipeline that runs a fast sample of the workload suite on affected PRs and enforces a 5% regression threshold on median token latency and 3% on throughput; failures produce an actionable perf report link.
A lightweight dashboard in Grafana that surfaces CI gate history, flaky test detection, and a comparison view between current PR build and golden baseline.
Public docs for oncall and engineers describing how to add workloads, update baselines (approval workflow), and triage gate failures.
Benchmarks show reduced noise: 95th percentile CI run-to-run variance <4% for median latency measurements across repeated short runs.
Integration tests that exercise kernel-selection fallbacks and attention-optimized kernels to ensure CI gates detect both correctness and perf regressions.
Design doc linked and reviewed by Applied ML and Runtime teams; at least one kernel-change PR blocked by a failing perf gate during rollout to dedicated clusters if regression detected.
SLO for gate runtime: PR perf gate must complete within 30 minutes for typical change surface.
Owners assigned for baseline maintenance and gate triage (runtime-performance oncall rotation).
